svg.text: Asynchronous clock loop (sky130_fd_sc_hd cells). VALID = comparator has decided.
CLKC falls as soon as VALID rises and rises again one delay-line time (XD1..XD2) after the comparator is back in reset:
that delay is the DAC settling time. The loop stops when the last bit is decided (DECL) and during sampling (CLKS high).
